# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run}/artifacts

Lists all artifacts for a specific workflow run in a repository

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-293`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| run | path | integer | True |
| name | query | string | False |
| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |

## Response

**200** — ActionArtifactsResponse

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `artifacts` | []*ActionArtifact | List of artifacts |
| `total_count` | int64 | Total number of matching artifacts |

- **400** — Invalid request parameters
- **404** — Repository not found

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | GetArtifactsOfRun | controller | Extract run ID from path; Extract optional name query param; Call db.FindAndCount with FindArtifactsOptions |
| 2 | [services](../modules/services.md) | convert.ToActionArtifact | utility | Build API URL from repo APIURL + artifact ID; Map fields: ID, Name, SizeInBytes, Expired, URLs, timestamps; Create minimal WorkflowRun with RunID, RepoID, CommitSHA |
